payload.text: hv, 26 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window, relayed by devbin-vc at its date -u of 10:43Z and read by vc at 10:44Z. As devbin-vc gives it: hv calls an estate-wide localfold and compact, cycle 5, now; hv compacts each seat when it is folded and quiet, devbin-vc last. The rest is the wording of devbin-vc and vc. For Utilz: no run starts. cc stops the Save fix at a safe point and banks its branch as it stands, with a note of what is done and what is left; ic does the same for the start and end marks. Each seat localfolds without a release: it archives what is finished, clears what is handled, commits its own board files and records by path, keeps its RESUME current, and sets a one-line focus that says where it resumes. No push. main stays at the seats' fold commits on top of the sweep 86448b67. vc sends devbin-vc one message with each seat's fold sha, main's tip, the banks, what waits on hv (the live Save with the marks, the push, the cut) and each resume line, then tells hv the seats are safe to compact. After the compact each seat runs /in-session and goes on from its resume line; the Desk reads every ask again.
